subject: Caching: Changing code blocks from echo=FALSE to echo=TRUE requires re-run

messages.author: 13ecb3e4561d1276
messages.subject: Caching: Changing code blocks from echo=FALSE to echo=TRUE requires re-run
parts:
Hi,

I have a .Rnw file which contains some code that takes quite a while to run. I have been using the cashing so that it doesn't take a day every time I compile the document. I having also been switching back and forth between echo=TRUE and echo=FALSE, using the setup code

    opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,tidy=TRUE,cache=TRUE)

as some of my advisers don't like to read over the R code, however, every time I switch, the code has to be rerun. Is there any way to get past this so that I can switch back and forth without having to rerun? 



Thanks!

Clark Kogan
